items.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: “Hey Frank, did you hear Diz? Yeah who’s with him? How’d he sound”

ctx.x: And then another thing that, that bothers you about that is that has nothing to do with the quality of the music, the art form, or the cultural context.

That’s right. Well they don’t care about that. They’re making a deadline that’s what it is. And I’ve seen a lot of the better known critics come and say, “Hey Frank, did you hear Diz? Yeah who’s with him? How’d he sound” Like I ain’t got time to get over there, but “Was it all right?” They’ve just got so much work to do they haven’t got time to cover everything he’s got to cover and he’s got to get the article out. But people believe what they read, which is not good. Because a lot of it has got nothing to do…
You know this is something that one of the other musicians that we interviewed talked about. He said it’s important to hear this music live.
